description: Lelord Kordel (December 16, 1908 – July 3, 2001) was a Polish American nutritionist and author of books on healthy living. He was consulted by top Hollywood stars and earned several awards, but was fined and imprisoned for making false claims about his products. Kordel promoted a low-carbohydrate high-protein fad diet. (Source: Wikipedia, 2025)
title: Lelord Kordel
